recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13459; future changes to this extension should be evaluated in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by reintroducing extension source into core.
issue_request: FHIR-13459 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by Patient Care and requested changing extension-allergyintolerance-certainty from a required coded extension to CodeableConcept with an extensible binding so local SNOMED CT certainty concepts could be represented.
initial_application: Historical core commit 50cb53f9114776e8bdefa48a848c0fd4bf49b7a5 applied the seed by changing the AllergyIntolerance extensions spreadsheet from code/required to CodeableConcept/extensible for allergyintolerance-certainty. This followed FHIR-11020, which moved AllergyIntolerance.reaction.certainty from the base resource to an extension, and FHIR-10369, which requested broader certainty-code support.
additional_context: The R5-era core source removed the AllergyIntolerance extension definitions, and the Extension Pack documentation states that globally defined extensions moved out of core starting from R5. The current Extension Pack source for StructureDefinition/allergyintolerance-certainty still applies at AllergyIntolerance.reaction and constrains Extension.value[x] to CodeableConcept with strength extensible against reaction-event-certainty. Later FHIR-37637 explicitly confirmed the binding was already extensible and removed the stale AllergyIntolerance Trial Use note that had called it required.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core source change is appropriate because the relevant source now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and already matches the seed resolution.
